cohort: A total of 696 pregnant women in their second trimester, with a mean age of 31.6 years, participated in the study.
finding: Overall fear of childbirth did not significantly differ between pregnant women before and during the COVID-19 pandemic, although pregnant women with a high school education level had a significantly higher fear of childbirth.
cross-section timing: July and December 2019 (pre-pandemic), and November 2020 and May 2021 (pandemic)
